admin.home.step1_desc: Write and work smarter with Brix AI — describe what you want changed and let it configure your cart drawer, upsells, and banners for you.
admin.home.step2_desc: Set colours, layout, and header for your slide-out cart, then preview it live before publishing to your store.
admin.home.step3_desc: Show frequently bought together products in your cart drawer and on product pages.
admin.home.step4_desc: Build a discount banner with targeting rules so the right shoppers see the right offer at the right time.
admin.home.step5_desc: Create high-converting product bundles with Combo Builder — customise layouts, preview live, and publish in just a few clicks.
admin.home.step6_desc: Understand revenue, funnels, and conversion rates in real-time so you know what to optimise next.
admin.home.tip1_body: Honest urgency, like "Only 3 left" on low-stock items, helps shoppers decide.
admin.home.tip2_body: Combine FBT upsells with a threshold coupon to maximise average order value.
admin.home.tip3_body: Set your cart drawer colour to match your primary CTA button for higher trust.
admin.home.tip4_body: Use the cart drawer, FBT and coupon blocks together so shoppers see offers at each step.
admin.home.tip5_body: Checking your funnel weekly helps you spot drop-off points before they cost you.
admin.home.tip6_body: Generate 3 coupon title variants with Brix AI — test them and keep the winner.
